technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with RSI and trend confirmation, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, creating conflicting intermediate-term signals and limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: EXPD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days.

sentiment.summary: Congressional insiders show consistent selling pressure (3 sales, no buys); market fear (41 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (411.68), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, and earnings in 36 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9 bullish, Supertrend, PSAR) with price near support (96.90) offers tactical entry for mean-reversion trade in fear-zone opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental weakness (score 3), congressional insider selling, VIX crisis (411.68), price below all key moving averages (50/200 SMA, EMA 20/50), below Ichimoku cloud, earnings risk in 36 days, and macro headwinds (flat yield curve, rising DXY) create overwhelming structural headwinds that outweigh short-term momentum.
